newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malpac, Advance Synergy extend suspension.
newsitem.headline: Malpac, Advance Synergy extend suspension.

text.p: Suspension of trading in the shares of Malaysia's Malpac Holdings Bhd, Advance Synergy Bhd and United Merchant Group Bhd has been extended on the request of the companies, the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) said on Tuesday.

It said in a statement that Malpac's suspension has been extended for eight more market days to June 2 as the company was waiting for Bank Negara Malaysia's approval for a planned acquisition of a financial services company.

In a separate statement, KLSE said the suspension of Advance Synergy and United Merchant was also extended for eight market days. Advance Synergy is planning to announce a restructuring involving United Merchant, the statement said.
The two companies were also waiting for Bank Negara's approval.
